authority: Host game's semantic input resolver; the Visual Atlas renderer is not a combat engine

floating.left_stick: move Sky and provide directional locomotion
floating.sword_command: cast, slash, control and charged vortex

held.right_stick: aim held slashes or intentional throws
held.sword_command: throw blade and detach from hand

remote.right_stick: steer or designate target for distant blade
remote.attach_release_recall: request controlled recall; never teleport weapon

gestures.gamepad: Hold RT at least 350 ms while floating (optional right-stick circle refines vortex)
gestures.keyboard_mouse: Hold F at least 350 ms (optional mouse circles refine vortex)
gestures.note: No compulsory stick-circle gesture; controller and keyboard both have a simple hold alternative

gestures.gamepad: R3 anchor, then A on eligible sword contact
gestures.keyboard_mouse: G anchor, then Space on eligible contact
gestures.note: Requires host ability unlock, collision and re-jump rules

gestures.gamepad: RB tap near hovering or returning sword
gestures.note: At sword_grab_lock hilt attaches to animated hand; no instantaneous snap

gestures.gamepad: Held: RT tap to throw; away: RB hold to recall
gestures.keyboard_mouse: Held: F tap to throw; away: R hold to recall
gestures.note: Different game modes prevent conflicts; sword remains independent world actor
Target retention allows right thumb to leave stick; attack cancels require host legality
Combo input buffer and coyote time belong to host

analog_policy.sample: 2d vector after circular deadzone, camera-space to world-space mapping

haptics.response: optional single alert; never constant buzz

rules: Action mapping always has mouse+keyboard equivalent; no mandatory motion control, vibration or stick gesture
Input schema is host adapter proposal, not a new visual pack kind
Vortex hold should not trigger both cast and vortex; input resolver commits action at release or charge threshold
Hold/tap conflicts require deterministic resolution and controller remapping
Right-stick guidance with face buttons uses retained aim and assisted targeting, never requires a simultaneous right-thumb press on both
Body animation contains no sword pixels; independent floating actor transfers to hilt attachment at explicit marker
Damage/reach/physics/iframes/hitstop/combos reside in host gameplay; Visual Atlas provides synchronized visual animation cues
All optional haptics are accessible, user adjustable, and repeatable without haptics
Gamepad and keyboard-mouse layouts must be reviewed for hold fatigue and input rollover
